skill.summary: Query Dutch field hockey match schedules and results from KNHB Match Center (hockeyweerelt.nl). Use when looking up hockey clubs, teams, upcoming matches, or...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of knhb-match-center skill.

- Query Dutch field hockey match schedules and results from the KNHB Match Center.
- Search and list clubs, filter by name or city.
- List all teams of a club, with type (outdoor/indoor) and next match date.
- Retrieve upcoming and played matches for any team, including detailed match info and scores.
- Includes usage notes for team categories, datetime handling, and season structure.
